s.zh: 征召时自动施放（征召待命或战斗中）
s.en: Autocast while drafted (on standby or in combat)

s.zh: 未征召时自动施放（平时也会给受伤 / 需要的人放）
s.en: Autocast while undrafted (also casts on the injured / those in need normally)

s.zh: 攻击类能力不能在未征召时自动施放
s.en: Attack abilities can't autocast while undrafted
Don't autocast when resource is below

s.zh: 选中的人只改这一个能力。征召时的开关也可以直接左键点按钮右上角的小角标，右键角标打开这个窗口。
s.en: Changes only this ability for the selected people. The drafted toggle can also be switched by left-clicking the small badge at the button's top right; right-click the badge to open this window.
